name: Survey tile in Scorpius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Scorpius, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 8 visits over 78 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 42 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.3 days starting 2026-02-23, at wavelengths from 0.85 to 4.88 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
